title: Legal Drunk Drivers from the 1960s
summary: A 1967 current-affairs segment interviews habitual drunk drivers just before the UK introduced the breathalyser. They insist they drive fine after drinking.
why: Used as a historical analogy for public resistance to new safety rules, and as an amusing vox pop.

quote.text: Here's one vox pop with the introduction of breathalizers in UK (1967)
